devices.title: Attendance devices
devices.text: ZKTeco fingerprint and card devices on the office network: their punches come into attendance by themselves.
devices.empty_text: Add a device with its IP address on the office network (Menu > Comm. > Ethernet on the device).
devices.sync_ok: Read: {recorded} punches went to attendance, {unmatched} wait for their person to be matched.

device.name: Name
device.protocol_hint: UDP works for most devices; choose TCP if UDP does not answer.
device.comm_key_hint: As set on the device (Menu > Comm. > Comm Key); leave empty for none. It is never shown again.
device.import_from_hint: Older punches stay on the device.

match.title: Device users
match.text: Who each user of the device is. Their waiting punches go to attendance as soon as they are matched.
match.empty_text: Read the device first (Read now on the devices page).
match.matched: Matched to {name}; {recorded} punches went to attendance.

reasons.no_answer: It did not answer. Check that it is on, its network cable, and its IP address and port.
reasons.wrong_comm_key: Its comm key is different. Type the one set on the device.
reasons.refused: It refused the connection. Try again in a minute, or restart the device.
reasons.read_failed: It stopped answering while sending its logs. Try again.
